title: Someone just ran one of the biggest AI models in the world on an old laptop
description:
Someone just ran one of the biggest AI models in the world on an old laptop. A developer named Farid Khan rewrote the entire inference engine from scratch. The whole engine is just a couple hundred kilobytes. And it runs a 1.5 terabyte model on a single CPU. The output matches the version running on a server with hundreds of gigabytes of RAM.

#ai #llm #deepseek #opensource #github #localllm #inference #cpu
